identification.method: Free-run two-state model least-squares; ZOH relay states, 2 s integration, initial stored heat fitted. Offline scipy differential_evolution, seed 42.
identification.warning: Lag hit the 5 s lower bound and initial heat hit the 2-heater upper bound: inertia is not reliably identified. High-temperature predictions are extrapolations.

metric_definitions.settling_min: Last exit from +/-2 C plus one simulation step, with >=600 s remaining inside band, measured from start; null if not settled or faulted.
metric_definitions.mean_tail_error_C: Mean signed error during final 1800 s; null after safety fault.
metric_definitions.max_tail_abs_error_C: Maximum absolute error during final 1800 s; null after safety fault.
metric_definitions.max_transitions_per_relay_per_hour: Largest per-relay transition count divided by hours until fault or simulation end, including startup and safety transition.
metric_definitions.minimum_normal_dwell_s: Minimum between normal relay changes; excludes immediate safety shutdown.
metric_definitions.initial_C: 21.8 except explicit 60 C hot restart; no physically stored energy at start of synthetic runs.
metric_definitions.peak_C: Maximum model average over the entire run, including passive coasting AFTER a latched OFF fault; may exceed the software cutoff.
